cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Carry this table with me, please. One end each; I'd like us to move something as partners.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stronger. I can carry it alone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Strength isn't the plan. Keep it level with me; we can decide where it goes together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Take that end. I'll put us beside the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask me about the window before we lift. A shared load needs a shared destination; please don't turn me into the handle you carry it by.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 corrects strength into coordination and A5 asks destination agreement before lifting, using professional moving method to redefine help as partnership.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 carry-alone offer gets shared level/decision requirement; B4 agrees to shared load but chooses window, causing A5 actual consultation request.

relationship.evidence: B2/B4 offer efficient help then accommodate A while retaining a practical preference.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 partial cooperation to extend partnership from carrying to deciding.

specificity.evidence: A1 table/two ends and B4 window make the physical task clear without hidden movement.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 handle image supports a concrete ask, not an abstract friendship speech.
